Fixes portal transfer loops that could immediately send returning players back to another server.

- Moves players onto loaded, solid ground outside the entire portal frame and nearby portals before a server transfer.
- Waits three seconds after moving, then checks the player's actual position again before transferring. Failed moves, missing safe exits, and portal re-entry cancel the transfer.
- Rechecks joining players as their login position settles. Players arriving inside a portal must leave its trigger area before it can activate again, even after the cooldown expires.
- Invalidates pending transfers when players disconnect or the plugin stops.
- Adds 18 regression tests, including large portals, reconnects, late position restores, and failed teleports.

Install the wheel on each server using Portals, remove the older Portals wheel, and restart Endstone. Existing portal definitions remain compatible.

Validation: 18 automated regression tests pass and the wheel builds successfully. Live Endstone/BDS testing has not been performed.
